page.layout: One page of text; marginal note in the left margin beside the first lines ("I. Veterum."). Printed page number at the head, centred. No running head. Catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: I. Veterum.exstent Carthaginenses duæ, Milevitana & Araufficana posterior. Sed & altera, cui patrocinatur Grotius hic, & infrà. Hic, in comendandâ antiquitatis, præsertim Cœlestini, Rom. Episcopi, modestiâ, in hoc argumento, ad condemnandas opiniones alias, non ulteriùs progressâ. Expositâ enim (Epistolâ pro Prospero & Hilario, ad Galliarum Episcopos, Adversarios Augustini, pro gratiâ Dei, contra liberum arbitrium pugnantis) fide catholicâ, (capitum septem titulorum, à quarto usque ad decimum) addit ex epilogo: Profundiores verò difficiliôresque partes intercurrentium quæstionum, quas latiùs pertractarunt, qui Hæreticis restiterunt, (Augustinum inprimis indicans) sicut non audemus contemnere; ita non necesse habemus adstruere, quia, ad confitendam gratiam Dei, cujus operi ac dignationi nihil penitus subtrahendum est, (ergo nihil de æternitate, nec perseverantiâ illius) satis sufficere credimus, quicquid secundùm prædictas regulas Apostolicæ sedis nos scripta docuerunt: ut prorsus non opinemur Catholicum; quod apparuerit præfixis.

page.notes: Text is largely italic in the original; italics are marked where the type clearly changes, roman passages in parentheses are set roman. The name "Prospero" is read from a worn word and may be slightly uncertain. The reading of the first line "exstent" and the Epistle title in the parentheses is from a small, faint print. The printed 's' long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
